newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific Texas gas well at 39 mmcf/day.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific Texas gas well at 39 mmcf/day.

text.p: Union Pacific Resources Group Inc Wednesday said its Bluebell Unit Well No. 2, located in Washington County, Texas, was producing at a rate of 39 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of natural gas. The well, part of the Austin Chalk horizontal well group, was drilled to 14,894 feet and completed as a triple lateral, with dual opposing laterals in the Georgetown formation and one lateral in the more shallow Austin Chalk formation.
The Georgetown formation was successfully tested during drilling and will be produced at a later date. UPR holds a 100 percent working interest in this well, Union said.
